capabilities_done: adjust.rs: versioned Adjustments recipe parameter (ADJUST_VERSION 1.0) on DevelopRecipe.adjust, identity by default, all families validated even while disabled (invalid_adjustment / non_finite), authored values retained when a group is off

slice 1: incremental temperature/tint = Bradford adaptation in the working space (assumed illuminant = D50 displaced along the Kim Planckian locus by -t*100 mired and along the locus normal by tint*0.02 uv); contrast/highlights/shadows/whites/blacks = monotone PCHIP knots in the sRGB-encoded domain applied per channel (contrast K=0.6 polynomial S-curve); vibrance (low-saturation weighted, skin-hue protected) and saturation about the encoded luma; clarity = whole-frame local contrast (3-pass box blur radius 2% of the short side, midtone weighted) in develop_to_image only

slice 2: 8-band HSL mixer (red orange yellow green aqua blue purple magenta, smoothstep partition-of-unity weights, hue +-30 degrees, saturation, luminance) in HSV of the encoded value; parametric tone-curve regions (4 amounts + 3 split points, STU-RAW-112) as a second PCHIP

slice 3: local.rs Correction/Mask: linear gradient, radial gradient (angle, roundness, feather, flipped), brush (dab list rasterised at render resolution, flow, feather), add/subtract, inverted, mask value, correction amount gain, normalised +-1 local stack (STU-RAW-122) driving exposure, temperature, tint, contrast, highlights, shadows, whites, blacks, saturation, clarity through the same adjust.rs maths; row-band parallel, thread-invariant; brush rasterisation budget

slice 4: output.rs render_output / develop_to_output: 8/16-bit (big-endian) interleaved sRGB-TRC RGB + ICC bytes (header check, hash bound to recipe.output_profile.sha256), ClipReport for clamped values
stage C: the new per-pixel stages run only when active; the digest-pinned paths are untouched (tests/develop_digest.rs unchanged and green)

enables: enable_colour_adjustments / enable_detail / enable_mask_group_based_corrections / enable_tone_curve now execute; the tile API refuses clarity and local corrections as unsupported_contribution:clarity_whole_frame / mask_group_whole_frame

spec_basis.STU-RAW-110: incremental temperature/tint are a relative offset, soft range -100..100; the raw kelvin form is NOT implemented
spec_basis.STU-RAW-112: parametric highlights/lights/darks/shadows plus three split points (defaults 25/50/75; only the shadow split default is derived in the spec)
spec_basis.STU-RAW-115: eight fixed hue bands, hue/saturation/luminance, identity 0
spec_basis.STU-RAW-121: correction/mask record (amount is a gain; mask value, inverted, blend 0/1; linear/radial/brush geometry; dab list re-rendered at the current resolution)
spec_basis.STU-RAW-122: the local stack is on a normalised +-1 scale, converted not reinterpreted
spec_basis.STU-CON-045: no folio path in develop; brush rasterised locally

unverified_choices_for_D5: all numeric mappings: knot weights and amounts (A_BLACKS 0.12, A_SHADOWS 0.20, A_HIGHLIGHTS 0.20, A_WHITES 0.12, contrast K 0.6, parametric 0.15), temperature 100 mired and tint 0.02 uv at +-100, hue band centres, band hue span 30 degrees, vibrance skin protection, clarity radius 2% and gain 0.8
slider hard bounds are `unknown` in the spec; out-of-soft-range values are REFUSED (conservative), not clamped
mask_blend_mode 0 = add, 1 = subtract; `flipped` read as inversion; brush radius as a fraction of the shorter side; local exposure +-4 stops; radial midpoint validated but unused
luma weights default Rec.709 (Adjustments.luma); working RGB->XYZ default sRGB (Adjustments.working_to_xyz_d50): the caller must set both for a non-sRGB working space
